nodes.name: ISpaceService.ts
nodes.summary: Domain port for the CLI space service, exposing default space lookup, space listing, slug resolution and the API host/organization context.

nodes.name: IAddToPackageUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for adding standards, commands or skills (by slug) to a Packmind package, returning which items were added versus skipped.

nodes.name: ICheckCliVersionUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for checking the running CLI version against the latest published release and reporting whether an update is available.

nodes.name: ICheckDiffsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for checking grouped artefact diffs against the server, reporting for each diff whether a matching change proposal already exists.

nodes.name: ICheckUpgradesUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for previewing package upgrades from packmind.json, describing per-package version moves and per-artifact added/updated/removed/rerendered changes, plus orphan artifact changes.

nodes.name: ICreatePackageUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for creating a new Packmind package in a space, returning the created package id, name, slug and space slug.

nodes.name: IDiffArtefactsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ArtefactDiff type and the use case contract that diffs locally installed artefacts against the server versions for given packages, git target and agents.

nodes.name: IEnsureCliVersionUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract that reconciles the running CLI version with the cliVersion recorded in packmind-lock.json, returning a discriminated outcome (no-lockfile, match, newer with skill reinstall, older).

nodes.name: IExecuteSingleFileAstUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for running a detection program against a single file's content for a given programming language, returning violation line/character positions.

nodes.name: IGetGitRemoteUrlUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port type alias for the git remote URL lookup use case, reusing command/result types declared in the application-layer implementation.

nodes.name: IGetPackageSummaryUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for fetching a package summary from the API, deriving the CLI command from the shared GetPackageSummaryCommand minus user and organization ids.

nodes.name: IInstallDefaultSkillsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for installing Packmind default skills into a workspace (version and beta filtering, agent override), reporting created/updated files and incompatible skills, plus bootstrapping packmind.json in empty directories.

nodes.name: IInstallPackagesUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for pulling package content and rendering it into the workspace, with git target info for removal detection and counts of created/updated/deleted files and artefacts.

nodes.name: IInstallUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for the top-level install command: installs parsed packages with optional upgrade and home-agent modes, and returns file change counts, resolved agents, source artifacts and access issues.

nodes.name: ILintFilesAgainstRule.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for linting files under a path against a single standard rule (draft, language and diff modes supported), returning violations and a summary.

nodes.name: ILintFilesFromConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for linting files using the standards configured in the workspace, with diff mode and ignore patterns, returning violations and a summary.

nodes.name: IListCommandsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for listing commands (recipes) of a space, returning their id, slug, name and space id.

nodes.name: IListFilesInDirectoryUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port type alias for the directory file listing use case, reusing command/result types from the application-layer implementation.

nodes.name: IListPackagesUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for listing the packages of a space.

nodes.name: IListSkillsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ListedSkill shape and the use case contract for listing skills of a space.

nodes.name: IListStandardsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for listing standards of a space, returning ListedStandard entries from the Packmind gateway types.

nodes.name: ILoginUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for logging the CLI into a Packmind host, optionally with a login code, returning the stored credentials path.

nodes.name: ILogoutUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for logging out of the CLI, reporting whether a credentials file or environment variable was present.

nodes.name: IMoveToPackageUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for moving artefacts into a target package, reporting per artefact whether it was added and which packages it was removed from.

nodes.name: IRemoveFromPackageUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for removing artefacts from a package, reporting per artefact whether it was removed and which packages still hold it.

nodes.name: ISubmitDiffsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for submitting grouped artefact diffs as change proposals with a message, reporting submitted, already-submitted, skipped and errored items.

nodes.name: IUninstallUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for uninstalling packages from a workspace, reusing the install result shape since uninstall runs an install pass.

nodes.name: IUploadSkillUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for uploading a local skill directory to Packmind, returning the skill id, version and upload size details.

nodes.name: IWhoamiUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for the whoami command, returning a discriminated authenticated/unauthenticated result with host, organization, user and expiry details.

nodes.name: IGetTrackingInfoUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract returning a read-only view of whether Packmind tracks the local git repository, including tracked versus current branch and detached-HEAD state.

nodes.name: ITrackRepositoryUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Port contract for setting, moving or removing Packmind tracking of a git repository branch, delegating confirmation to a caller-provided callback before any mutation.

nodes.name: embedded-wasm.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated module embedding tree-sitter WASM grammar binaries as base64 strings so the bundled CLI can extract them at runtime for AST-based linting.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by apps/cli/scripts/embed-wasm-files.ts; large base64 payloads inlined in a Record<string,string> to ship binaries inside a single-file bundle.
